REPORT
Subject (in full) Article entitled "Immoral doings on Yuhang Road" appearing in
the Shanghai Nippo of October 28, I930.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I.Moore.
See also
D. 1663 for
another
indecent article.
Sir,
I beg to report, with reference to the article entitled
"Immoral doings on Yuhang Road" appearing in the Shanghai Nippo
of October 28, I930, (translation attached), that C.D.I.Nakagawa
saw the Magistrate of the Japanese Court re. the article in
question, who stated that there was insufficient grounds to
take action against the Shanghai Nippo, and also that the paper
was of no consequence and not worth serious attention.
D.S.I.

报告
事由（全称）：关于1930年10月28日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登的题为“余杭路之不道德行为”的文章。
由副督察长穆尔（D.S.I. Moore）呈报。
另见
D. 1663号，
涉及另一篇
淫秽文章。
敬启者：
兹就1930年10月28日《上海日报》刊登的题为“余杭路之不道德行为”的文章（译文附后）呈报如下：日本法院首席侦探中川（C.D.I. Nakagawa）已就该文事宜会见日本法院推事，该推事表示，对《上海日报》采取行动的理由不足，并指出该报无足轻重，不值得认真关注。

October 29, 1930.

Immoral doings on Yuhang Road

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following :

At about 2 a.m. two or three days ago the inmates
of a Chinese house at No. 3960 Yuhang Road heard
knocking at the back door. They opened a window on
the first floor and saw a woman dressed in Japanese
clothes in sexual intercourse with a man dressed in
European clothes. During the act their feet came
against the door but they did not notice this because
of the sexual excitement.

S 5 ( H. J. Moore ) ,
Please ascertain with the assistance
of the C. D. I. Kobayashi, Japanese
law on the subject of indecent
publications, and obtain the
opinion of the Legal Department
on the advisability of prosecuting the
editor of the paper?
J M

1930年10月29日。

余杭路之不道德行为

《上海日报》刊载如下内容：

两三天前凌晨2时许，余杭路3960号一华籍住户听到后门有敲门声。他们打开一楼窗户，看见一名身穿和服的女子与一名身穿欧式服装的男子正在发生性关系。过程中，两人的脚撞到了门，但由于性兴奋，他们并未察觉此事。

S 5 （ H. J. Moore ） ，
请在小林首席侦探（C. D. I. Kobayashi）的协助下，查明日本法律关于淫秽出版物的规定，并征询法律处意见，以评估起诉该报编辑是否适宜？
J M

October 29, 1930. Morning Translation.

HIGHWAY ROBBERY OF A JAPANESE DANCING GIRL

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following
reports:-
At 3.30 a.m. October 27 a Japanese dancing
girl named Takuko, 26, of the Golden Star Cabaret,
residing at No. 1104 North Szechuen Road, was attacked
by two Chinese on North Szechuen Road near the Japanese
School whilst she was returning home in a ricsha. She
was deprived of a handbag containing Yen 30 and $151
in cash, a dancer's licence, a silver medal and a
Ruby ring. She immediately reported the matter to
Dixwell Road Station.

LARCENY FROM JAPANESE HOUSE

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following
reports:-
At 3 p.m. October 28 a thief entered the
Damura Yoko on Nanzing Road and carried off several
ivory articles valued at $60.

IMMORAL DOINGS ON YUHANG ROAD

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following
reports:-
At about 2 a.m. two or three days ago the
inmates of a Chinese house at No. 3960 Yuhang Road,
heard knocking at the back door. They opened a window
on the first floor and saw a woman dressed in Japanese
clothes in sexual intercourse with a man dressed in
European clothes. During the act their feet came
against the door but they did not notice this because
of the sexual excitement.

（批：The Legal Dept. will be consulted M）

（批：Newspaper Consulted. Recd 29/10 M）

（批：M）

1930年10月29日。晨间译文。

日本舞女遭拦路抢劫

《上海日报》刊载如下报道：
10月27日凌晨3时30分，金星舞厅（Golden Star Cabaret）26岁的日本舞女多古子（Takuko），住址为北四川路1104号，在乘人力车返家途中，于北四川路近日本学校附近遭到两名华人袭击。她被抢去一个手提包，内有现金30日元及151美元、舞女执照、一枚银质奖章和一枚红宝石戒指。她随即向狄思威路捕房报案。

日籍住户失窃案

《上海日报》刊载如下报道：
10月28日下午3时，一名窃贼进入南京路的大村横弄（Damura Yoko），盗走数件象牙制品，价值60美元。

余杭路之不道德行为

《上海日报》刊载如下报道：
两三天前凌晨2时许，余杭路3960号一华籍住户听到后门有敲门声。他们打开一楼窗户，看见一名身穿和服的女子与一名身穿欧式服装的男子正在发生性关系。过程中，两人的脚撞到了门，但由于性兴奋，他们并未察觉此事。

（批注：将咨询法律处 M）

（批注：已查阅报纸。10月29日收悉 M）

（批注：M）
